purpose: Product detail page that hosts the add-to-cart form (form id pd-form, quantity field addtocart_{productId}.EnteredQuantity).

success.bodySignal: HTML title 'Shop. TRANSOCEAN CHRONOGRAPH'; Add to cart link is JS-driven (href '#')

purpose: Add a product to the cart (cartType 1) via XHR form post; repeat adds of the same product accumulate quantity on one cart line.

bodyFields.name: addtocart_{productId}.EnteredQuantity
bodyFields.description: Quantity to add. Missing field adds 1. 0, negative or non-numeric gives success:false 'Quantity should be positive'.

pathParams.name: productId
pathParams.description: Numeric product id (1 = TRANSOCEAN CHRONOGRAPH). Unknown numeric id gives 200 + redirect JSON; 0 or non-numeric gives 404.

pathParams.name: cartType
pathParams.description: 1 = shopping cart (observed from the UI). Value 99 returned success:true but did not change the cart count; other values not explored.

failure.bodySignal: Invalid quantity: {"success":false,"message":["Quantity should be positive"]}. Unknown productId 999999: {"redirect":"/"}. productId 0 or abc: HTTP 404 HTML. GET method: 404. Bodyless POST must still send Content-Length (curl -d '') or IIS returns 411.

mergedNotes: cart-update (EP-CART-UPDATE-SETUP-ADD) used POST /cart/addproduct/8/1 with an empty body and Content-Length: 0 as setup; cart-remove used it with product 1. Same endpoint, folded in here.

observations.evidence: captured from the browser XHR and replayed; quantity 1 -> count 1, again -> 2, quantity 3 -> 5; 0/-1/abc give 'Quantity should be positive'
curl replay with quantity 1 returned {"success":true}; no non-default quantity was sent with this name

conflicts.resolution: addtocart_{productId}.EnteredQuantity is the confirmed name (it is what the UI sends and quantities other than 1 were honored). The AddToCart.* variant also returned success:true, but cart-add observed that a body without the quantity field adds 1, and cart-remove only sent 1, so its success is consistent with the field being ignored (inference, not tested with qty != 1).

observations.value: empty body with Content-Length: 0, product 8, cartType 1 -> {success:true}

conflicts.resolution: Consistent with cart-add (missing quantity field adds 1).

purpose: Return the mini-cart (offcanvas) HTML fragment with the current cart lines, quantities and subtotal.

success.bodySignal: text/html fragment div.offcanvas-cart-body with item rows (input name item.EnteredQuantity, data-sci-id = cart line id, data-update-url /shoppingcart/updatecartitem), subtotal, links to /cart and checkout. In the browser, right after an add it also contained an alert 'The product <name> has been successfully added to your cart'; the curl replay did not show that alert.

failure.bodySignal: POST without Content-Length: IIS 'HTTP Error 411'. GET also returns 200 with the same fragment.

purpose: Return the header counters (cart, wishlist, compare item counts) as JSON; the UI calls it after each add and on every page load.

query.name: cart
query.description: Include CartItemsCount (the UI sends cart=True after an add).

query.name: wishlist
query.description: Include wishlist counter (page load sends cart=True&wishlist=True&compare=True).

success.bodySignal: JSON {"CartItemsCount":n,"WishlistItemsCount":n,"CompareItemsCount":n}. CartItemsCount is the sum of quantities, not the number of lines.

failure.bodySignal: GET returns 404 HTML; POST without Content-Length returns 411.

mergedNotes: Also called by the UI in cart-update and cart-remove browser flows (cartsummary?cart=True and ?wishlist=True) as a header refresh; not exercised further by those units.

purpose: Set the quantity of one cart line (identified by sciItemId) and return the recalculated line and order totals as JSON including rendered cart HTML.

query.name: sciItemId
query.description: ShoppingCartItem id of the line, taken from the id/name itemquantity<id> on GET /cart or the data-href of the quantity input.

query.name: isCartPage
query.description: Sent by the UI on /cart; selects the cart-page rendering of the response.

query.name: newQuantity
query.description: Also accepted in the query string (model binding); the UI sends it in the body.

bodyFields.name: newQuantity
bodyFields.description: Integer quantity. 1..min(10000, stock) updates the line; 0 or negative removes the line; above 10000 or stock is rejected; non-numeric/empty/decimal/missing yields a 502 from the load balancer.

success.bodySignal: JSON {success:true, SubTotal:'$9.50 excl tax', message:[], cartHtml:'<html of the cart rows>', displayCheckoutButtons:true, newItemPrice:'$1.90 excl tax'}; cartHtml contains the new line total and the order total; GET /cart then shows the new itemquantity<id> value.

failure.bodySignal: Over limit: 200 with JSON {success:false, message:['The maximum quantity allowed for purchase is 10000.'] or ['Your quantity exceeds stock on hand. The maximum quantity that can be added is 8563.'], SubTotal unchanged}; quantity unchanged. Quantity 0 / negative: line is removed but response is 500 {error:true, controller:'shoppingcart', action:'updatecartitem', message:'Object reference not set to an instance of an object.'}. Unknown sciItemId or an item owned by another visitor: 500 same body, nothing changed. Non-numeric/empty/2.5/missing newQuantity: 502 HTML 'Bad Gateway' (awselb/2.0). GET: 404.

conflicts.topic: unknown/foreign line id behaviour differs from delete/move

observations.value: unknown sciItemId or another visitor's line -> HTTP 500 NullReference body, nothing changed
deletecartitem / moveitembetweencartandwishlist with unknown or foreign id -> HTTP 200 success:false

conflicts.resolution: Not a contradiction (different endpoints), but error contracts are inconsistent across the three mutating endpoints.

observations.value: failure.status is recorded as 200 but its bodySignal also documents HTTP 500 (qty <= 0, unknown id) and 502 (non-numeric/empty/missing newQuantity)

conflicts.resolution: Record kept unchanged; the real failure statuses are 200, 500 and 502 depending on the case (see bodySignal).

purpose: Render the shopping cart page (server-rendered HTML), including the empty-cart state and per-line remove/move links.

success.bodySignal: Non-empty: lines with data-href="/shoppingcart/deletecartitem?cartItemId=<id>" and ".../moveitembetweencartandwishlist?cartItemId=<id>&cartType=ShoppingCart&isCartPage=True" plus inputs itemquantity<id>. Empty: text "Your Shopping Cart is empty!" (data-empty-text attribute is always present, so do not match on it alone).

mergedNotes: cart-update's record of the same endpoint: HTML; one <input id="itemquantity<id>" value="<qty>" data-href="/shoppingcart/updatecartitem?sciItemId=<id>&isCartPage=True"> per line; text '$X excl tax' for unit price, line total and Subtotal; summary table with Subtotal/Shipping/Tax/Total. (base record taken from cart-remove, which also documents delete/move links).

observations.value: empty cart renders without any itemquantity<id> inputs; Set-Cookie SMARTSTORE.VISITOR and ASP.NET_SessionId
empty text 'Your Shopping Cart is empty!' also present in non-empty carts (data-empty-text); detect emptiness by absence of cartItemId links; SMARTSTORE.VISITOR only on first request

conflicts.resolution: Compatible. Use absence of cartItemId / itemquantity<id> markers, never the empty text.

purpose: Remove one line from the cart by its cart item id.

query.name: cartItemId
query.description: Cart line id (not product id), taken from the /cart HTML. Ids are global counters, not 1..n.

contentType: none (empty body; send Content-Length: 0, e.g. curl -d '')

success.bodySignal: JSON {success:true, message:"The product has been removed.", cartItemCount:<n>, cartHtml, totalsHtml, displayCheckoutButtons}. After the last line cartItemCount is 0.

failure.bodySignal: Unknown id, already-removed id, or id owned by another visitor: JSON {success:false, displayCheckoutButtons, message:"An error occurred during the removal of the product."}. GET gives 404 HTML. Missing or non-numeric cartItemId gives 502 Bad Gateway (HTML).

purpose: Move a cart line to the wishlist (the line leaves the cart and gets a NEW id on the wishlist).

query.name: cartItemId
query.description: Id of the line in the cart.

query.name: cartType
query.description: Source list of the line: ShoppingCart (move to wishlist).

query.name: isCartPage
query.description: UI flag; the UI always sends True. Effect of omitting it not tested.

contentType: none (empty body; send Content-Length: 0, otherwise IIS answers 411)

success.bodySignal: JSON {success:true, wasMoved:true, message:"The product has been added to your wishlist", cartHtml, totalsHtml, cartItemCount, displayCheckoutButtons}. Line now appears on /wishlist with a new cartItemId.

failure.bodySignal: Unknown id: JSON {success:false, message:"Product could not be added to the shopping cart."} (wording is misleading). POST with no Content-Length: 411 HTML. GET: 404 HTML. Missing cartItemId: 502 HTML.

mergedNotes: Same path and method as EP-CART-MOVE-TO-CART; the direction is chosen by the cartType query value (ShoppingCart vs Wishlist).

observations.value: the unknown-id failure text 'Product could not be added to the shopping cart.' was observed for the Wishlist->Cart direction; the same text for the ShoppingCart->Wishlist direction is listed but not separately verified

purpose: Move a wishlist line back into the cart (the line gets a NEW id in the cart).

query.name: cartItemId
query.description: Id of the line on the wishlist, from the /wishlist HTML.

query.name: cartType
query.description: Source list of the line: Wishlist (move to cart).

query.name: isCartPage
query.description: UI flag; the UI sends True.

success.bodySignal: JSON {success:true, wasMoved:true, message:"The product has been added to your shopping cart", cartHtml, totalsHtml, cartItemCount, displayCheckoutButtons}.

failure.bodySignal: Unknown id: JSON {success:false, message:"Product could not be added to the shopping cart."}.

mergedNotes: Same path and method as EP-CART-MOVE-TO-WISHLIST; direction chosen by cartType=Wishlist.

purpose: Render the wishlist page (server-rendered HTML) so wishlist line ids can be read and emptiness checked.

success.bodySignal: Lines carry data-href=".../moveitembetweencartandwishlist?cartItemId=<id>&cartType=Wishlist&isCartPage=True". Empty: "The wishlist is empty!" (data-empty-text also always present).
